corrections.problem: List citations did not include the explicit reverse-engineering question that frames Dhor’s answer.
corrections.action: Added the interviewer question passage to the citations.

corrections.problem: Attribution to gardeners alone was ambiguous; cited paragraph first says robotic grays repair the body, while gardener frequency is a reference.
corrections.action: Generalized attribution to the described gray procedures and preserved both the soul and frequency conditions.

corrections.problem: Conflated Atlas-origin “Alantes” with “Atlantes” in a separate answer.
corrections.action: Separated the Atlas-origin group from the Atlantes she says she has seen.

corrections.problem: “Mandated birth control” reverses the source’s explicit statement that no governmental rule exists.
corrections.action: Clarified that birth control is not government-imposed and is only personal.

corrections.problem: “Kilometer-scale shipyards” could imply the shipyards themselves are kilometer-scale; source specifies facilities for building/repairing and docking ships up to a kilometer.
corrections.action: Rephrased as facilities to build, repair, and dock kilometer-scale ships. Also tightened other phrasing to keep the article at 84 words.

corrections.problem: “Federation biosphere ship” was not supported by the cited passages or the full source; the speaker only identifies the Moon as a damaged, abandoned spherical spacecraft.
corrections.action: Removed unsupported ownership and biosphere details, retaining its relation to the lunar frequency-control Matrix.

corrections.problem: Claim that repairs and supplies are handled onboard overstated source’s qualification that only supplies or isolated repairs may require mothership support.
corrections.action: Narrowed the statement to rare mothership needs and retained onboard parts replicator.

corrections.problem: Claim cited only the first and last items in a multi-factor list, omitting passages that explicitly support food chemicals and electromagnetic radiation.
corrections.action: Added the missing diet, radiation, and age-of-onset/context passages to citations.
